title: Procyclical And Counter Cyclical Economic Policies
definition: Procyclical economic policies amplify macroeconomic fluctuations by expanding during booms and contracting during recessions, whereas countercyclical policies stabilize the business cycle by dampening excesses through fiscal and monetary interventions.
importanceInUpsc: Directly tested in Prelims (Economy, Fiscal Policy, Monetary Policy instruments like Countercyclical Capital Buffers) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Economic Development, Growth, Inflation, Macroeconomic stability, and management of economic shocks).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Procyclical And Counter Cyclical Economic Policies.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of National Income, Business Cycles, Fiscal Policy, and Monetary Policy
